📖 How to read this report — all indicators run on Daily · Weekly · Monthly
Score = weighted sum: Daily (1×) + Weekly (0.7×) + Monthly (0.4×) — each timeframe scored independently
🔥 CROSS = fresh crossover/breakout within last 3 bars (highest priority)  |  ⚡ = strong signal  |  ✅ = confirmed signal  |  ↓ = negative/bearish
Periods auto-scale per timeframe so every indicator fires meaningfully:
Indicator Daily Weekly Monthly Why
CCI Short2005020All ≈ 1–2 year lookback. Cross above +100 = trend breakout
CCI Long100020050All ≈ 4 year lookback. Major multi-year base breakout
MACD Slow34,200,934,50,912,26,9Slow EMA flip = major trend change
MACD Ultra34,1000,934,200,934,50,9Ultra-slow flip = decade-level trend change
MFI141414>70 = institutional flow; >80 = strong buying
Donchian252/65 bars52/26 bars12/6 barsAll ≈ 52-week / 26-week price highs
Bollinger202020Squeeze→expansion; price above upper band
ADX+DI141414>25 = trend; >35 = strong trend; +DI > -DI = bullish
Chande KrollATR(10)+Q(9)samesamePrice crossing above CKS stop = trend inception
🛡 Stop Loss — 4 methods (all shown, ⭐ = recommended for momentum)
Method Formula Best for Note
⭐ ATR 1×cur − 1.0 × ATR(14)Momentum (default)Tight. Broken = momentum failed. Exit immediately.
ATR 2×cur − 2.0 × ATR(14)Swing tradeWider cushion; tolerates intraday shakeouts.
CKSChande Kroll Stop lineTrend inceptionLevel price just crossed above. Re-crossing down = trend inception failed.
Base20-bar low × 0.98Wide structuralBase support with 2% buffer. Use when staying in a multi-day swing.
📐 Upside Targets — 5 methods (goal: ride daily trend with big move + volume)
Method Formula T1 / T2 / T3 Best when Advantage / Limitation
⭐ M1 ATR Multi cur + N × ATR(14) 1.5× / 2.5× / 4.0× / 6.0× Always — use as default ATR already encodes volatility + recent momentum energy. Bigger ATR = bigger realistic targets. Universal.
⭐ M2 Z-Score cur × (1 + N × ret_std60) 1.5σ / 2.5σ / 4.0σ today_z ≥ 1.5σ (unusual move) Calibrated to THIS stock's 60-bar return distribution. today_z shows if today is already a σ-event. Best for catching acceleration.
M3 Avg Daily Range cur + N × ADR(20) 1× / 2× / 3× Sanity check vs typical range Intuitive: "T1 = one typical day's move." Limitation: range-based, not direction-aware. Use to validate M1/M2.
M4 Fibonacci base_high + ratio × range 127% / 162% / 200% / 262% Clean base/consolidation box Self-fulfilling resistance (many traders use these levels). Best for chart-based entries with a clear 20-bar base.
⭐ M5 Vol-Surge cur + N × ADR × surge_mult 1× / 2× / 3.5× (× surge) vol Z-score ≥ 3 (extreme) Higher volume conviction = can sustain larger move. surge_mult = clamp(vol_z, 1, 5). At Z=4, targets are 4× larger than ADR alone.
Auto-recommendation: vol Z ≥ 3 → M5 · today_z ≥ 2 → M2 · default → M1  |  Highlighted box in Targets column = auto-recommended method for this stock today  |  R/R = reward-to-risk ratio (e.g. 3.2:1 = ₹3.20 potential per ₹1 risked vs ATR1× stop)
📊 Volume Suite (8 methods, max 10 pts) — computed on each timeframe:
  vs SMA20 ≥2x✅ ≥3x⚡ ≥5x🔥  ·  vs EMA20 (faster baseline)  ·  vs SMA50 (longer baseline, filters noise)  ·  Z-Score σ≥2✅ σ≥3⚡ σ≥4🔥 (statistically unusual)
  ATH Vol all-time high or within 10%/25% 🔥 (ultimate conviction)  ·  DRY→Surge 5-bar quiet then explosion (VCP accumulation breakout)  ·  OBV new 20-bar high (smart money confirmed)  ·  Trend 5D>10D>20D average (rising accumulation)
Volume detail row (below D score) shows all 8 sub-signals for that timeframe's bars. W and M volume uses weekly/monthly bars — a 5x weekly surge = 5x vs 20-week average, which is extremely rare.
